mapper.select: SELECT attribute_code AS attributeCode, jurisdiction_code AS jurisdictionCode, party_type AS partyType, data_type AS dataType, catalog_code AS catalogCode, sensitivity, vault_data_type AS vaultDataType, max_length AS maxLength, format_regex AS formatRegex, label_key AS labelKey, status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM t_attribute_definition WHERE jurisdiction_code=#{jurisdictionCode} OR jurisdiction_code IS NULL ORDER BY attribute_code
